summary: Dinova operates a corporate business-dining network connecting more than 24,000 restaurants across the U.S. and Canada with roughly 600 corporations, government agencies, and SMBs; it is a demand-generation/referral network, not a POS or payments vendor.

Dinova's Spring 2026 State of Business Dining Report estimates business dining at roughly $250 billion in annual spend, nearly 23% of all U.S. restaurant expenditure, based on analysis of 27 metro markets and 500+ companies across nine sectors. (Scope note: Figure is Dinova's own market-sizing estimate, not independently audited.)

Dinova continues to actively grow its restaurant network, adding 27 new restaurant partners effective September 15, 2026, part of a recurring cadence of quarterly/bi-monthly partner additions through 2026.
